findings.title: The notes do not say whether the owner's own till, card reader and distributor are supported

location.description: the three notes under the hero, starting with "Works with your till"

findings.viewer_experience: An owner cannot tell whether their till, card reader or distributor works with Shelfmark, and "Returns are tracked for you" does not say who tracks them. The trial button asks them to commit on trust.

current.value: the notes name no till, card reader or distributor and do not say who tracks returns

findings.target: the notes state the supported tills, card readers and distributors, who tracks returns, and one comparison with how the owner works now
findings.fix_direction: The maker must supply the supported tills, card readers and distributors, who tracks returns, and one comparison with how the owner works now. Then edit the notes to state those facts. Do not invent them.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees in the notes, at desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen, the named tills, card readers and distributors, who tracks returns, and one comparison with how the owner works now, all supplied by the maker.

findings.title: Note 1 is 44 characters per line, one short of the 45 convention
findings.viewer_experience: It still reads comfortably; only the number is one short.
findings.target: 45 characters per line, only if the maker wants the number met
findings.fix_direction: Change the column width of the notes only if the maker wants the 45 met.

closed_when.check: characters_per_line of section.facts > p:nth-of-type(1) in the desktop and widescreen viewports is 45 or more

findings.title: On the phone, note 2 breaks between "One" and "click"

location.description: note 2, "Orders from your distributor. One click sends your reorder list in your distributor's format."

findings.viewer_experience: The phrase "One click" is split across two lines.
findings.target: "One click" stays together on one line
findings.fix_direction: Put a non-breaking space between "One" and "click".

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees "One click" on one line in note 2 in the phone viewport.
